metadata.title: Retro-Futuristic Jukebox Emblem over Night Cityscape

retrievalProfile.description: A central glowing neon circular emblem with chrome accents hovering over a dark, silhouetted city skyline under a hazy gradient sky.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn textures are preferred over airbrushed gradients

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly symmetrical composition featuring a central, multi-layered circular emblem resembling a stylized jukebox or spacecraft. The emblem is composed of concentric rings of glowing red, yellow, and blue neon tubes, held together by ornate chrome or metallic brackets. In the center of the emblem is a stylized, cursive monogram. The background consists of a dark, hazy sky with soft, cloud-like forms and a silhouetted city skyline at the bottom with glowing windows.
coreVisualRelationships: The central emblem acts as the primary focal point, radiating light into the surrounding dark atmosphere.
The city skyline at the bottom provides a sense of scale and grounding to the floating central object.
The typography is positioned at the top, balanced against the weight of the city at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Concentric neon rings in primary colors
Chrome or metallic ornate structural elements on the emblem

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The emblem is centered both horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central glowing emblem is the primary anchor, supported by the horizontal line of the city at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the glowing center, moves upward to the text, and then descends to the cityscape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample dark, hazy space surrounds the emblem, creating a sense of depth and isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue and metallic silver (emblem details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central emblem against low-saturation, dark values in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to cool, dark tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The monogram inside the emblem is custom-lettering with a thick, cursive, interconnected script and a 3D bevel effect.

typesetting.case: Sentence case for top line, All caps for second line

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the upper negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, modern sans-serif paired with a highly decorative, 3D beveled script monogram.

avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, classic geometric feel of the era's typography.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and uniform stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, hazy indigo background with a silhouetted city skyline at the bottom featuring tiny glowing yellow windows. In the center, place a large, ornate circular emblem made of glowing red, yellow, and blue neon tubes with chrome brackets.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the title text in a clean, white geometric sans-serif font at the top center. The first line should be sentence case and the second line all caps with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the neon colors vibrant against the dark background?
Is the city skyline silhouetted with distinct window lights?
Is the typography clean and legible at the top?

mustRedesign: The specific monogram inside the emblem must be a unique design
The exact arrangement of the city buildings
postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance of the central emblem.
Ensure the neon glow does not wash out the chrome details.
Verify the text is centered and has wide tracking.
Confirm the city skyline is at the very bottom edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central glowing [Object] + [Chrome/Metallic] accents + [Dark Atmospheric] background + [Silhouetted Cityscape] + [Geometric Sans-Serif] typography at top.
